The Wedding Feast at Cana is stored by name (housed_in the Louvre) or relative to the Mona Lisa (a rule over housed_in). q1 uses the catalogued chain housed_in o located_in ⊑ located_in; its original answer (Paris) rests on the record's q1 bridge 'The Louvre is in Paris' (firm). q3 compares two works' museums (fol).

fol.notes: housed_in is a function (RELATIONS.md: functional; an artwork is housed in one museum at a time), over an enumeration of the named works and museums plus other_museum, so 'the same museum' is equality of the two works' housed_in values. w1 stores The Wedding Feast at Cana under the Louvre by name, so it stays when the Mona Lisa moves; w2 stores it as hanging opposite the Mona Lisa, in the same room, so in the same museum.

label_corrections.why: 'Same museum' over the functional housed_in is a join over named individuals: wedding : housed_in some (inv(housed_in) value mona); the 'no' in w1 follows from functionality and the Louvre and the National Gallery being distinct. No arithmetic.
